exams.name: Dentistry Licensing Examination (written and practical)
exams.notes: Commission may accept a certificate from a national or regional testing organization in lieu of all or part of the written examination. Commission may accept proof of an accredited residency in lieu of the practical examination.
exams.quote: Pass an examination prepared or approved by and administered under the direction of the commission. The dentistry licensing examination shall consist of practical and written tests upon such subjects and of such scope as the commission determines.

exams.notes: Required for compact privilege; accepted by participating states in lieu of state written exam.

exams.quote: accept the national board examinations of the joint commission on national dental examinations or another examination accepted by commission rule as a licensure examination

required.quote: The commission shall establish continuing dental education requirements.

available.quote: An applicant holding a valid license and currently engaged in practice in another state may be granted a license without examination required by this chapter, on the payment of any required fees

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license in another state and either (a) be a graduate of a commission-approved dental college/school, or (b) have practiced at least four years in another state AND completed a one-year postdoctoral residency approved by the commission. Commission may also require documentation of licensure, disciplinary history, and knowledge of Washington law.
requirements.quote: An applicant holding a valid license and currently engaged in practice in another state may be granted a license without examination required by this chapter, on the payment of any required fees, if the applicant: (a) Is a graduate of a dental college, school, or dental department of an institution approved by the commission under RCW 18.32.040(1); or (b)(i) Has practiced in another state for at least four years; and (ii) Has completed a one-year postdoctoral residency approved by the commission.

title_protection.quote: The fact that a person uses any dental degree, or designation, or any card, device, directory, poster, sign, or other media whereby he or she represents himself or herself to be a dentist, shall be prima facie evidence that such person is engaged in the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the person's profession, whether the act constitutes a crime or not.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining a license or in reinstatement thereof.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining a license or in reinstatement thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: All advertising which is false, fraudulent, or misleading.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising which is false, fraudulent, or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice which results in injury to a patient or creates an unreasonable risk of harm.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice which results in injury to a patient or which creates an unreasonable risk that a patient may be harmed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation, or restriction of the individual's license to practice any health care profession by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension, revocation, or restriction of the individual's license to practice any health care profession by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Possession, use, prescription for use, or distribution of controlled substances or legend drugs other than for legitimate or therapeutic purposes, or diversion of controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The possession, use, prescription for use, or distribution of controlled substances or legend drugs in any way other than for legitimate or therapeutic purposes, diversion of controlled substances or legend drugs, the violation of any drug law, or prescribing controlled substances for oneself

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any state or federal statute or administrative rule regulating the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any state or federal statute or administrative rule regulating the profession in question, including any statute or rule defining or establishing standards of patient care or professional conduct or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with the disciplining authority by not furnishing documents, explanations, or responses to subpoenas.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate with the disciplining authority by: (a) Not furnishing any papers, documents, records, or other items; (b) Not furnishing in writing a full and complete explanation covering the matter contained in the complaint filed with the disciplining authority; (c) Not responding to subpoenas issued by the disciplining authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplining authority or a stipulation for informal disposition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplining authority or a stipulation for informal disposition entered into with the disciplining authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice when a license is required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice when a license is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations of rules established by any health agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violations of rules established by any health agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice beyond the scope of practice as defined by law or rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice beyond the scope of practice as defined by law or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or fraud in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or fraud in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately supervise auxiliary staff to the extent that the consumer's health or safety is at risk.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to adequately supervise auxiliary staff to the extent that the consumer's health or safety is at risk

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a profession involving contact with the public while suffering from a contagious or infectious disease involving serious risk to public health.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a profession involving contact with the public while suffering from a contagious or infectious disease involving serious risk to public health

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion for personal gain of any unnecessary or inefficacious drug, device, treatment, procedure, or service.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion for personal gain of any unnecessary or inefficacious drug, device, treatment, procedure, or service

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the person's profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine, or the treating, operating, or prescribing for any health condition by a method, means, or procedure which the licensee refuses to divulge upon demand of the disciplining authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: The willful betrayal of a practitioner-patient privilege as recognized by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful betrayal of a practitioner-patient privilege as recognized by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation or use of threats/harassment/financial inducements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation of facts before the disciplining authority or its authorized representative, or by the use of threats or harassment against any patient or witness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Current misuse of alcohol, controlled substances, or legend drugs.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Current misuse of: (a) Alcohol; (b) Controlled substances; or (c) Legend drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abuse of a client or patient or sexual contact with a client or patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abuse of a client or patient or sexual contact with a client or patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross, willful, or continued overcharging for professional services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the term 'unprofessional conduct' as used in RCW 18.32.530 through 18.32.755 includes gross, willful, or continued overcharging for professional services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting third-party payer payment as full payment in abrogation of the copayment provisions of a contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unprofessional conduct under this chapter and chapter 18.130 RCW for a dentist to abrogate the copayment provisions of a contract by accepting the payment received from a third party payer as full payment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing conversion therapy on a patient under age eighteen.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing conversion therapy on a patient under age eighteen

definition_quote.value: A person practices dentistry, within the meaning of this chapter, who (1) represents himself or herself as being able to diagnose, treat, remove stains and concretions from teeth, operate or prescribe for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw, or (2) offers or undertakes by any means or methods to diagnose, treat, remove stains or concretions from teeth, operate or prescribe for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition of the same, or take impressions of the teeth or jaw, or (3) owns, maintains, or operates an office for the practice of dentistry, or (4) engages in any of the practices included in the curricula of recognized and approved dental schools or colleges, or (5) professes to the public by any method to furnish, supply, construct, reproduce, or repair any prosthetic denture, bridge, appliance, or other structure to be worn in the human mouth.
definition_quote.quote: A person practices dentistry, within the meaning of this chapter, who (1) represents himself or herself as being able to diagnose, treat, remove stains and concretions from teeth, operate or prescribe for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or physical condition of the human teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw

methods_authorized.quote: The practice of dentistry includes the performance of any dental or oral and maxillofacial surgery. 'Oral and maxillofacial surgery' means the specialty of dentistry that includes the diagnosis and surgical and adjunctive treatment of diseases, injuries, and defects of the hard and soft tissues of the oral and maxillofacial region.

drug_authority.value: Licensed dentists may prescribe drugs necessary in the practice of dentistry; registered pharmacists may fill such prescriptions. The commission must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs. Dentists must inform patients of their right to refuse opioid prescriptions.
drug_authority.quote: Registered pharmacists of this state may fill prescriptions of legally licensed dentists of this state for any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry.

specialist_license_available.quote: The commission may, in its sole discretion, may permit the applicant to be licensed without examination, and with or without conditions, if it is satisfied that the applicant meets all the requirements for licensure in this state and is competent to engage in the practice of dentistry.

value: off-site supervision (practice arrangement plan for senior centers)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: 'Close supervision' means that a supervising dentist or supervising dental therapist whose patient is being treated has personally diagnosed the condition to be treated and has personally authorized the procedures to be performed. ... 'General supervision' means that a supervising dentist or dental therapist has examined and diagnosed the patient and provided subsequent instructions to be performed by the assistive personnel, but does not require that the dentist or dental therapist be physically present in the treatment facility.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Enter into a written practice arrangement plan, approved by the department, with a dentist licensed in this state, under which the dentist will provide off-site supervision of the dental services provided.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: dental hygienists licensed under this chapter with two years' practical clinical experience with a licensed dentist within the preceding five years may be employed, retained, or contracted by health care facilities and senior centers to perform authorized dental hygiene operations and services without dental supervision.

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: Notwithstanding any prohibitions in RCW 18.260.040, the performance of the following services under the close supervision of a supervising dentist or supervising dental therapist as the dentist or dental therapist may allow: (i) Placing and carving direct restorations; and (ii) Taking final impressions.
